newsitem.title: USA: Nations Fund to sell products via Schwab.
newsitem.headline: Nations Fund to sell products via Schwab.

text.p: Nations Fund said Tuesday it would begin selling some of its mutual funds through Charles Schwab Corp's Mutual Fund OneSource service.
Initially, it would offer seven funds through the service: the International Equity, Emerging Markets, Pacific Growth, Global Government Income, Value, Equity Income and Emerging Growth funds.
Nations Fund is a unit of NationsBank Corp, based in Charlotte, N.C.

Mark Williamson, president of NationsBanc Advisors Inc, which manages the 44-fund complex, said the move was an effort to widen distribution, which has been confined to a relatively small geographical area.

The firm, with $18 billion in assets, also announced a multifaceted marketing strategy, including an increase in its sales force, the introduction of a national advertising campaign and the enhancement of its cash-management products and services.
The program will include a direct mailing to 10,000 financial planners.
